claims: Delhi is the National Capital Territory (NCT).
Delhi is located in northern India on the west bank of the Yamuna River.
Delhi is the entire union territory.
New Delhi is a specific municipality within Delhi.
New Delhi serves as the seat of the Government of India.
Red Fort is a prominent tourist site in Delhi.
Humayun’s Tomb is a prominent tourist site in Delhi.
Qutb Minar is a prominent tourist site in Delhi.
Jama Masjid is a prominent tourist site in Delhi.
Chandni Chowk is a prominent tourist site in Delhi.
Delhi has a history dating back to 1,000 BC.
The British officially moved the capital from Kolkata to New Delhi in 1911.
The redevelopment of the MG Road stretch to connect Delhi and Gurugram is actively underway.
New Delhi serves as the seat of all three branches of the Indian government.
